hook: Jujutsu: version control without Git's sharp edges.

beats.say: Ethan Lowman's primer introduces jj to Git users. It works side by side with Git in the same repository, so you can try it today.
Automatic rebasing and native undo soften Git's sharp edges, and make stacked-diff workflows easy.
Each change keeps a stable change ID even as its commit hash changes, so rewriting or editing history never loses track of your work.
